$comment: Each fix gbrain's improvement crew ships for a nightly finding: issue (tracker id), pr (gbrain pull request), gbrain_version (the first version carrying it), suite (a dev-set suite id), items (the dev-set item ids that exposed it) and an optional note. The nightly report shows each fix's items every night, so a fix that regresses shows up next to the record of shipping it. For the SOTA fix ledger (eval/runner/sota/ledger.ts) a fix also names its target: { bucket, cause, signature } from the weekly fix list and held_out_share, the bucket's share of held-out questions once custody measures it (null until then). ledger records what the ledger measured: dev (the same-night master-against-stable contrast on the fix's items, with the noise baseline, collateral losses, success rate and the D6a prediction), release (its share of the release's held-out contrast) and revert (the revert-build verdict, only for a fix predicted at 3 points or more).
